chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Abū Muḥammad al-Wajnānī, that he informed me from one who saw him, that he came out of the house ten days before the event, while he was saying:
O Allah, You know that it is among the most beloved of places, were it not for the expulsion—or words close to this.

key_terms.أَحَبِّ: most beloved; expressing deep attachment and preference
key_terms.الطَّرْدُ: expulsion; being driven away or forced out
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; an invocation addressing Allah directly in supplication
key_terms.الْبِقَاعِ: places/spots; referring to locations of special love
key_terms.الْحَادِثِ: the event/occurrence; the impending incident being referenced
key_terms.تَعْلَمُ: You know; affirming Allah’s knowledge of the inner state and circumstance

ai.seo_question: What did he say when leaving the house before the incident by ten days?
ai.summary: This report preserves a brief supplication uttered upon leaving a beloved place under compulsion. It conveys love for that place alongside submission to circumstances known by Allah.
